scope: Twenty-one previous rocker, guided and single-switch parallel native proofs are retained only with exact macro and installation-fixture hashes. Seven horizontal dual-switch variants are freshly audited: four PETG parts, three nominal 0.8 mm TPU gaskets, retained ST3215 and ASW-07D source units, manual ARM 1 on the left and servo-operated ARM 2 on the right. Every new variant retains 30 components and 61 valid closed solids through STEP and FCStd roundtrips without external component interference. Actual world geometry proves source orientation, a 150 by 100 mm default flange and both engraved legends with 0.6 mm depth, Z5.4 floor, stroke/counter/space probes and exact removed volumes. Only cloned geometry is rotated back for existing mechanical fixtures: through-tie engagement, rigid shoulders, gasket/guard-nut contact, body-pocket antirotation controls, ground-clip approaches, straight underside cable approach, external 1/3/6 mm host panels and cover/manual-lever sweeps remain checked. Rear right straight-key service requires guard removal. TPU compression, actual electrical plugs, delivered guard seating, force and material performance remain unverified.
